title: tehas analytics copy --json
description: What tehas analytics copy --to <file> --json prints, version 1, when it has written the copy: read from the copy, not from the factory's database. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. console/analytics/tests/command.rs checks what the program prints against it and the samples beside this file, and test/json_contract_test.sh checks the samples against it.

from.description: The oldest start of a run in the copy, Unix seconds. Left out when it has no run.

to.description: The newest end of a run in the copy, or its start for a run with no end, Unix seconds. Left out when it has no run.
